summary: Go SDK: non-streaming chat completion times out on large prompts
description: Customer reports synchronous (non-streaming) chat completion requests time out when prompts exceed ~120KB. They are not using streaming. Suspected default client timeout too low.
comments: Eng (Hiro): Confirmed default http.Client timeout was set to 30s globally; increased to 5m and made configurable.
Support (Grace): Customer confirmed fix in v0.9.3.
